formula: loan_amnt / annual_inc (build_features.py), no clip/min/max applied anywhere in the pipeline
interpretation: Train (2012-2013) has loans above 0.5 (max 0.7125), with little mass exactly at 0.5 (0.065%). Validation (2014) and test (2015) never exceed 0.5, and test shows 0.538% of loans landing exactly at 0.5 (7x validation's rate). This looks like a LendingClub underwriting policy (a hard loan-to-income cap around 50%) that tightened/became binding between the 2012-2013 and 2014-2015 vintages - a property of the raw data, not something introduced by our feature engineering.
